# Age VII produced goods. Per-good modifier types are generated by tools/goods_modifiers.py.

# Intermediate good like steel: no pop demand, consumed by mills, ships and construction.
tsin_engines = {
	category = produced
	color = goods_tsin_engines
	default_market_price = 6
	transport_cost = 1
}

# Consumed by tsin_fertilized_fields (farm RGO enhancement).
tsin_fertilizer = {
	category = produced
	color = goods_tsin_fertilizer
	default_market_price = 2.5
	transport_cost = 1
}

# Consumed by tsin_blasting_works (mine RGO enhancement) and railway construction.
tsin_explosives = {
	category = produced
	color = goods_tsin_explosives
	default_market_price = 5
	transport_cost = 1
}

# Raw goods (M3). No location starts with them: tsin_economy.80 turns jungle locations into rubber,
# and the tsin_prospect_for_oil decision opens oil fields. Demand comes from age VII production methods.
tsin_rubber = {
	method = gathering
	category = raw_material
	color = goods_tsin_rubber
	default_market_price = 4
	transport_cost = 1

	location_potential = {
		vegetation = jungle
		climate = tropical
	}
}

tsin_oil = {
	method = mining
	category = raw_material
	color = goods_tsin_oil
	default_market_price = 4
	transport_cost = 1.5
}

# Electricity (M5, docs/gate_g.md). Tradeable like every EU5 good; the high transport cost keeps it
# inside the market that generates it. No pop demand: consumed by electric production methods.
tsin_electricity = {
	category = produced
	color = goods_tsin_electricity
	default_market_price = 3
	transport_cost = 5
}

# Farm machinery (0.7 agricultural revolution). Made only by tsin_farm_machinery_works,
# consumed only by tsin_mechanized_farm maintenance. No pop demand.
tsin_farm_machinery = {
	category = produced
	color = goods_tsin_farm_machinery
	default_market_price = 5
	transport_cost = 1
}
